svg.text: Scheduler::_schedule for a NORMAL engine · every DP rank runs the same votes in the same step · commit 9bd9cf2
How does one step become prefill or decode?
A prefill is tried only at an attempt point. Two votes keep the step type the same on every DP rank.
Does this rank want a prefill?
Vote 1: all-reduce MIN over the DP group
ALL point: prefill if EVERY rank wants
ANY point: prefill if ONE rank wants
fills a prefill batch from waiting
Vote 2: did ANY rank schedule a prefill?
this rank has a batch: return it
decode_step counts decode steps since the last prefill step. Defaults: ALL every 70, ANY every 100.
decode_step 0 is an ALL point, so right after a prefill step the scheduler tries again: prefill steps come back to back
while every rank has work. With one DP rank, up to 69 more decode steps can run after a request becomes schedulable (if blocks and slots are free).
Not shown: a PROMPT engine always runs _schedule_prefill; a COMPLETION engine always runs _schedule_decode (scheduler.hpp:288-294).
With one DP rank the votes still run as all-reduce calls on a group of size 1 (scheduler.hpp:169-182).
